note: Schema-only manifest. No row data, emails, credentials, or secrets. Re-query before migration because production can change.

columns.name: title
columns.check: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) >= 2 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM title)) <= 120

columns.name: data_categories
columns.default_value: ARRAY['nombre completo'::text, 'correo electrónico'::text, 'T.I.'::text, 'grado/curso'::text, 'datos de pedidos y compras'::text, 'datos de puntos y recompensas'::text]

columns.name: relationship
columns.check: relationship IS NULL OR (relationship = ANY (ARRAY['Padre'::text, 'Madre'::text, 'Acudiente'::text, 'Tutor legal'::text, 'Abuelo/a'::text, 'Tío/a'::text, 'Hermano/a'::text, 'Familiar'::text, 'Otro'::text]))

columns.name: reason
columns.check: length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) >= 3 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) <= 500

columns.name: ingredient_name
columns.check: length(TRIM(BOTH FROM ingredient_name)) >= 2 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM ingredient_name)) <= 100

columns.name: ingredient_key
columns.check: length(TRIM(BOTH FROM ingredient_key)) >= 2 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM ingredient_key)) <= 100
